notes: The above information shows that in almost all the States & UTs who
provided the data on the subject, sufficient staff were available for administration
of jail institutions. Among the various categories, Jail Staff Cadre, who are
exclusively recruited for jail institutions, trained in jail management and
administration are posted in all the jails. This class of staff plays a major role and
formed a large percentage of the total jail staff in the various jails. The Jail Cadre
staff are ably supervised and controlled by officers and supported by Correctional
Staff, Medical Staff (exclusively for the jail and its inmates) and other staff. For
